content.text:
I fixed the bug in `outputLink` in `src/Tokenizer.ts`. I haven't run it or any tests, since the folder has no `node_modules`.

**Cause:** `outputLink` set `lexer.state.inLink` to `true` while it parsed the link or image text, then set it back to `false` when it finished. That is also what happens when the image `![logo](logo.png)` is parsed inside the outer link's text. The reset to `false` made the lexer think it was no longer inside a link, so the bare URL or email after the image was auto-linked (`Lexer.ts:511`). This also covers the https:// and reference-style cases, because they all go through `outputLink`.

**Fix:** `outputLink` now saves the previous `inLink` value before setting it to `true` and restores that value afterwards, instead of forcing `false`. Top-level links behave as before, because `inLink` is `false` there anyway.
